candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Internship in GenAI Knowledge Assistant for Engineering
letter.opening: I am applying for the internship on a GenAI Knowledge Assistant for Engineering. Letting engineers ask questions about technical documents and get source-grounded answers with citations is exactly what I built in my latest project, DocuMind (github.com/Rayyan3079/documind-rag), a RAG assistant over technical PDF manuals.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I worked with structured business data on SAP platforms as a Business Analyst and in SAP data consulting.

achievements.impact: DocuMind cites the file and page for every answer and says when information is not in the documents; it refused all 4 unanswerable questions in my test set
I built an evaluation harness with hit rate, MRR and an LLM judge: 91% correct on 22 questions, and hybrid BM25 plus vector search raised MRR from 0.748 to 0.898
in industry I built data models from ABAP CDS view sources and joins and validated them with SQL, which is the basis for querying structured engineering data

letter.problems_section: I would collect and preprocess engineering documents and datasets, compare RAG, Text-to-SQL and vector search options, build the natural-language workflows and measure answer quality with citations and evaluation sets. I have not used Databricks, Genie or MLflow yet, and I have no heat pump background, so I would learn the platform and domain from your engineers.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to the Stuttgart area for the 6-month internship and can start by agreement. As a non-EU student I will agree the weekly hours with you so they fit my permitted working days. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
